entry.name: rnbo_rampsmooth~
entry.description: Smooths an incoming signal . Each time an incoming value changes, it begins a linear ramp to reach this value.

arguments.name: up
arguments.description: Specifies the number of samples over which a signal will be smoothed when an incoming value greater than the current value arrives.

arguments.name: down
arguments.description: Specifies the number of samples over which a signal will be smoothed when an incoming value less than the current value arrives.
